text: Absolutely the best fajitas in under 15 minutes! I couldn't believe it only took 7 total minutes to cook...on the stove, NOT microwave! We absolutely love these fajitas! The only problem now is availability and being able to get them. It seems that a lot of local stores have taken them off the shelves and forget about Amazon because they're worse.

title: Yum!
text: This Chicken Green bean stir-fry from Kevin’s at Costco was really good! It was super simple to prep as well. We made ours over noodles but you could eat it plain or over rice. We were super impressed with it for a simple/easy lunch. We found these in the refrigerated section at Costco. 🙂

title: Another Kevin’s Hit!
text: I’m a big fan of Kevin’s products because they are so easy and convenient, but still feel fresh and healthy. The flavor of the sauce was excellent (but a little spicy!) and it was a very tasty dish. My only issue was the sous vide chicken - while it was tender and tasted good, the look of it coming out of the package really gave me some hesitation. But it didn’t end up tasting really good.

title: Has a little heat but it’s good!
text: We really liked the Sichuan Chicken & Green Bean Stir Fry! It had a good amount of heat and tasted a lot like Chinese takeout. It was a little too spicy for my toddler, but my husband and I really enjoyed it. It was also quick and easy to make!

title: We love Kevin's!
text: We love Kevin's Natural Foods products! We have had them in the past, but this one was a new one (Sichuan Chicken Green Bean Stir-Fry). I love them because they are so easy to make and they have such good ingredients. It took 10 minutes to cook and we served it over rice. The chicken and beans were great. We were not a fan of the sauce on it as it was too sweet for us. #sponsored

title: Sauce didn't taste 'fajita-like' to me
text: Think I may have tried a Kevin's product before, but regardless, was disappointed in the "Chicken Fajitas Skillet Meal Kit". Positives, the ingredients did seem fresh. Negatives, the vegetables were not substantial at all, and the biggest disappointment was the lack of a 'fajita taste'. The sauce was sort of tomato-like. Full kit made three flour taco-size tortillas. Gave it a shot, but will not purchase this one again.

title: I agree with the review too much orange
text: I love that the product has quality ingredients and fits into clean eating. The variety of options are great and I've tried a few items that I enjoyed. For this particular product, I agree with the review about the orange flavor being overwhelming. I was expecting more of the soy flavor based on the title of the package. I "saved" the overly sweet sauce by adding umami seasoning powder and red pepper flakes. The chicken portion is smaller than what I would use if I made the dish from scratch but was sufficient. They're were a good amount of green beans but the texture and color of them wasn't my preferred for stir-fry. To give you an idea of serving size adequacy, I made two packages and had a serving and my husband wiped out the rest for his dinner. So based on a price of $11 per package, size and flavor this just wasn't a win for me and not an item I'd try again.

title: We randomly try you food

title: Amazing for chipotle bowls.
text: I’ll start out by saying that I used by own onions and peppers in my photos. The first time I made this I used the whole kit for fajitas, but added kinder’s fajita seasoning and used less of the seasoning from Kevin’s. It was delicious in fajitas. I agree with the other reviews that there’s not much chicken. But as someone who hates cutting chicken - it is really convenient. The second time we made this I used my own peppers and onions as I do love fresh the most. We did the same as the first skillet with the seasoning and made our own bowls. If there’s two people - I think this is the way to go so you will feel fuller. The chicken is good quality and I feel good about the ingredients.
